# Catalogue search: authority, selective queries and scale qualification

## Decision boundary

PostgreSQL remains catalogue authority. First measure its existing B-tree and
inverted indexes against the required workload. A different engine must earn
its additional storage, synchronization and recovery cost in the same test;
an engine's release date does not establish a performance advantage.

The [disposable SQL harness](../../scripts/catalogue_bench/README.md) compares
the same synthetic corpus through raw-name, canonical-ID, external-ID, category,
episode and browse paths. Results belong with [the benchmark record](../project/benchmarks.md).
SQL latency is separate from end-to-end API latency and crawling yield.

## Facts, proposals and serving are different concerns

Raw metainfo, validated torrent identities and file inventory are catalogue
facts. A plugin's proposed type, match, title or language carries its processor
identity, source revision, version, confidence and verification/application
receipt. A proposal does not become authority merely because its confidence
number is high. Core validates the contract, source binding, candidate identity
and policy before accepting a mapping. Search consumes accepted facts; it never
calls a classifier or requires direct plugin database access.

Serving eligibility is checked against current catalogue authority before
sorting, grouping or limiting. An indexed identity, cached candidate or search
projection cannot override privacy, authentic quarantine, adult/name policy or
other configured exclusions. A plugin outage leaves discovery, indexing and
ordinary catalogue reads available; enrichment can catch up independently.

Unmapped, stale and uncertain annotations remain distinguishable. ID-only
search returns established mappings. It cannot certify an unclassified torrent
by guessing its identity. Generic text and raw-catalogue search remain separate
fallbacks. Raw-catalogue retrieval must also work when a content projection has
not yet been created.

## Query routing

Use `(content_type, content_source, content_id)` as a complete identity. Numeric
TMDB movie and TV IDs are different namespaces. v5.7.0 already supplies
`TorrentContentIdentityCriteria`; Torznab's typed TMDB path reuses it.

For external IDs, resolve a small set of canonical keys from authoritative
`content_attributes` with `key = 'id'`, source, value and content type. Probe
`torrent_contents` with that key set. Alternate titles and plugin annotations
with identical text are not identifiers. An `IN` semijoin also avoids row
multiplication when several aliases identify the same content. It gives the
planner an opportunity to drive release lookup from the small key set instead
of running a correlated OR subquery for every catalogue row.

A hot external alias still timed out in the 32M prepared-plan test even with
the ordered canonical index. The consumer search therefore first reads at most
two distinct existing canonical keys inside a read-only repeatable-read
transaction. Exactly one key adds direct equality predicates while retaining
the complete authoritative identifier guard. Zero or multiple keys retain the
full semijoin. This preserves OR semantics and avoids guessing which mapping
is correct. Lookup inherits the caller deadline and has a five-second ceiling;
the page, count and facets run serially on that same transaction connection.
Speculative query races cannot share or cancel that connection. The next
request observes any alias revocation committed after the snapshot began.

The [Torznab supportedParams revision](https://torznab.github.io/spec-1.3-draft/revisions/1.1-Newznab-supportedParams.html)
combines supplied ID systems with OR. Categories, type, episode/date and any
supplied text still constrain the result. An unknown IMDb mapping must not veto
a known TMDB or TVDB mapping. Advertise only implemented capabilities.

The inspected client implementations are pinned rather than inferred from
product names:

- [Sonarr request generation](https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/blob/b3d4bb8c18f7feb6744a6cd3231279a45351bb5e/src/NzbDrone.Core/Indexers/Newznab/NewznabRequestGenerator.cs)
  uses advertised TV IDs, season and episode parameters. It supports aggregated
  IDs and keeps title-search tiers. Daily shows use year plus `MM/DD`.
- [Radarr request generation](https://github.com/Radarr/Radarr/blob/56f6168bb6f254c9a34d0e5da76040dcb4215d3d/src/NzbDrone.Core/Indexers/Newznab/NewznabRequestGenerator.cs)
  uses TMDB/IMDb movie IDs and a title/year fallback tier.
- [Prowlarr request generation](https://github.com/Prowlarr/Prowlarr/blob/874e38b99e61c8c2da8f6e7c3d5128e002cc8b31/src/NzbDrone.Core/Indexers/Definitions/Newznab/NewznabRequestGenerator.cs)
  translates supported IDs and category mappings, and may send both text and IDs.

These clients also evaluate release names and attributes. There is no universal
`quality=` parameter that can safely be turned into a hard predicate for every
client. DH-Waypoint's implemented category subtypes can constrain resolution;
season packs must remain eligible for their contained episodes. The exact
supported parameters and profile limits are in the [API reference](../reference/torznab-api.md).

## Index and paging choices

Canonical release lookup already has the grouped-key index from migration
00036. Measure it before adding another identity index. A reverse external-ID
index can make the small-key lookup selective. Match B-tree leading equality
columns to actual predicates, as described by the
[PostgreSQL 16 multicolumn rules](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/16/indexes-multicolumn.html).

The existing content-name GIN index serves full-text search. Migration
[00006](../../migrations/00006_tsv.sql) removed raw `torrents.tsv` and its index.
The harness deliberately adds a synthetic raw TSV column to compare an
alternative query. Its baseline includes the initial migration's historical
TSV B-tree, which cannot serve `@@`; that extension is not the current backend
schema. GIN is the [documented preferred text-search index](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/16/textsearch-indexes.html).
The raw TSV experiment does not establish current raw API latency or storage.

REST v2 instead implements literal case-insensitive substrings with escaped
`ILIKE`, a minimum three-character query and canonical-hash cursors. Migration
00071 supplies its `GIN(name gin_trgm_ops)` index, using PostgreSQL's
[trigram support for ILIKE](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/16/pgtrgm.html#PGTRGM-INDEX).
Token-based TSV results are
an alternative SQL workload, not a measurement of that API. Qualify substring
queries and trigram construction separately before promoting API expectations.

Ordered page indexes can avoid sorting a large candidate set for `LIMIT`.
The [ordering documentation](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/16/indexes-ordering.html)
explains that tradeoff. Extra indexes also consume bytes and make updates more
expensive; retain the ones supported by measurements, not every candidate.
An episode GIN index is useful only when the actual predicate can use its
operators. A function call or JSON subexpression does not automatically use a
whole-document GIN index.

Migration 00072 adds the ordered canonical-identity and partial external-ID
lookup indexes. Wider published-page and typed-page experiments were rejected
after regressions at 32M. The retained canonical index orders by the complete
identity followed by `(published_at DESC, info_hash DESC, id DESC)` and excludes
unmapped rows. It uses
[concurrent construction](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/16/sql-createindex.html#SQL-CREATEINDEX-CONCURRENTLY)
outside a transaction. Concurrent construction still consumes I/O and disk,
and can wait for old transactions. A failed build may leave an invalid index;
inspect validity and remove that failed index before retrying the migration.
Qualify build time, temporary headroom and ingestion impact on a restored
catalogue before rollout. Up and Down affect only those two new indexes;
they do not recreate the raw TSV column/index already removed by migration6.
Full-chain downgrade tests preserve the existing evidence-bearing migration
holds. Historical migration files stay intact.

Published content pages use `(published_at, info_hash, id)`. `id` distinguishes
several content rows belonging to the same torrent. A deterministic order fixes
ties in a stable snapshot; it does not freeze concurrent inserts or mutable
ordering fields. Export consumers need a snapshot or documented high-water
mark if they require repeatable traversal.

Offset remains part of the Torznab contract. It is expensive for deep scans
because [PostgreSQL must process skipped rows](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/16/queries-limit.html).
Prefer a tuple cursor for long catalogue traversals and use `limit + 1` for
has-next-page. Raw hash traversal can use the primary key without a count.
The harness excludes cursor-anchor discovery from keyset timing, since the
caller already has that anchor.

For a classified-plus-unclassified fallback, apply eligibility inside each
disjoint branch before taking its top K. Merging those bounded branches can
produce the same first page as the complete union. Limiting first and filtering
afterward can silently lose eligible rows. A fallback candidate must retain its
uncertain status rather than acquire a canonical-ID claim from its text match.

## Alternatives and limits

An optional search projection can remain rebuildable from PostgreSQL. If used,
publish its source revision and lag, revalidate candidates against current
eligibility, and refill pages after rejected or missing candidates. Define
behavior when the projection is missing, stale or rebuilding. Do not require a
plugin to share database credentials to maintain that projection.

[OpenSearch exact term fields](https://docs.opensearch.org/latest/query-dsl/term/term/)
can represent IDs and facets, while its
[refresh model](https://docs.opensearch.org/latest/api-reference/index-apis/refresh/)
introduces a visibility boundary for new writes. A second service therefore
needs synchronization, recovery and freshness qualification in addition to
query timings. No OpenSearch speed advantage is claimed by this SQL benchmark.

[SQLite FTS5 external-content tables](https://www.sqlite.org/fts5.html#external_content_and_contentless_tables)
offer a compact embedded projection, but their content/index consistency is
the application's responsibility. Rebuild, concurrency and eligibility costs
would need measurement on the same workload. They have not been qualified as
an authority replacement here.

The SQL harness uses a reduced schema and declared synthetic skew. Literal SQL
plans do not prove every application prepared plan:
[PostgreSQL can choose generic or custom plans](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/16/sql-prepare.html).
Actual API hydration, snapshot validation, public traffic, cold storage devices,
mixed v1/v2 hash widths and long-term bloat remain separate qualification axes.
No latency figure should be promoted to an end-to-end service guarantee without
that evidence.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Plot measured warm SQL percentiles from summarize.py (requires matplotlib)."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
from matplotlib.ticker import FuncFormatter

p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
p.add_argument('summary',type=Path)
p.add_argument('--out',type=Path,required=True)
args=p.parse_args()
data=json.loads(args.summary.read_text())
groups=[r for r in data['latencies'] if r['cache_state']=='warm' and not r['concurrent_writes'] and r['plan_mode']=='literal']
sizes=sorted(set(r['rows'] for r in groups if r['rows']))
cases=[('raw_text_rare','Raw FTS · rare · alternative'),('external_keyset','External ID'),
       ('identity_hot','Canonical ID · hot'),('type_browse','Type browse'),
       ('offset','Offset · 1,000,000'),('keyset','Published cursor'),
       ('enriched_with_fallback','Full fallback union'),('enriched_bounded_fallback','Bounded fallback merge')]
variants=['baseline','candidate','retained']
colors={'baseline':'#8eacff','candidate':'#53dfb0','retained':'#ffbd73'}
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family':'DejaVu Sans','font.size':10,'figure.facecolor':'#111722',
                    'axes.facecolor':'#111722','axes.edgecolor':'#465267','text.color':'#edf1f7',
                    'axes.labelcolor':'#d1dae8','xtick.color':'#b7c5d8','ytick.color':'#dbe4f1',
                    'savefig.facecolor':'#111722'})
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,len(sizes),figsize=(max(7,5.4*len(sizes)),7.2),squeeze=False,sharey=True)
for ax,size in zip(axes[0],sizes):
    for ci,(case,label) in enumerate(cases):
        for vi,variant in enumerate(variants):
            row=next((r for r in groups if r['rows']==size and r['case']==case and r['variant']==variant),None)
            if row is None:continue
            y=ci+(vi-1)*.18
            if row['errors']:
                ax.scatter(5000,y,color=colors[variant],marker='>',s=45,zorder=3)
                continue
            if not row['samples']:continue
            ax.plot([row['p50_ms'],row['p95_ms']],[y,y],color=colors[variant],lw=2,alpha=.8)
            ax.scatter(row['p50_ms'],y,color=colors[variant],s=13,zorder=3)
            ax.scatter(row['p95_ms'],y,color=colors[variant],s=36,zorder=3,edgecolor='#111722',lw=.5)
    ax.set_xscale('log')
    ax.set_xlim(.03,8500)
    ax.set_ylim(len(cases)-.5,-.6)
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(cases)),[label for _,label in cases])
    ax.set_xticks([.1,1,10,100,1000,5000])
    ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(lambda x,pos:f'{x:g}'))
    ax.grid(axis='x',which='major',alpha=.18)
    ax.set_xlabel('SQL latency · ms · logarithmic scale',labelpad=12)
    ax.set_title(f'{size/1e6:g} million torrents',loc='left',fontsize=15,fontweight='bold',pad=18)
    ax.spines[['top','right','left']].set_visible(False)
    ax.tick_params(axis='y',length=0,pad=10)
legend=[Line2D([0],[0],color=colors[v],marker='o',lw=2,label=v.capitalize()) for v in variants if any(r['variant']==v for r in groups)]
fig.legend(handles=legend,loc='upper right',bbox_to_anchor=(.99,.99),ncol=len(legend),frameon=False)
fig.suptitle('Catalogue retrieval: measured p50 → p95',x=.02,y=.99,ha='left',fontsize=18,fontweight='bold')
fig.text(.02,.045,'Dots start at p50 and end at p95. Triangles mark query errors at the 5-second budget.\n'
         'Retained tested at 32M only. Synthetic SQL workload · PostgreSQL 16.15 · 6-CPU / 16-GiB cap · 30 scheduled warm observations · no HTTP latency claim.',
         fontsize=9,color='#b7c5d8',va='bottom')
fig.tight_layout(rect=(.01,.12,.995,.92),w_pad=2)
args.out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
fig.savefig(args.out,dpi=180)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Plot storage and observed mixed-write costs; never extrapolate capacity."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
p.add_argument('summary',type=Path)
p.add_argument('--out',type=Path,required=True)
args=p.parse_args()
data=json.loads(args.summary.read_text())
sizes=data['completed_scales']
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family':'DejaVu Sans','font.size':10,'figure.facecolor':'#111722',
    'axes.facecolor':'#111722','axes.edgecolor':'#465267','text.color':'#edf1f7',
    'axes.labelcolor':'#d1dae8','xtick.color':'#b7c5d8','ytick.color':'#dbe4f1',
    'savefig.facecolor':'#111722'})
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,len(sizes),figsize=(max(7,5*len(sizes)),8),squeeze=False)
for col,size in enumerate(sizes):
    storage={}
    for row in sorted(data['storage'],key=lambda r:r['at']):
        if row['rows']!=size or not row['file'].endswith('-indexes.jsonl'):continue
        variant=row['file'].rsplit('/',1)[-1].split('-')[1]
        if variant not in ['baseline','candidate','retained']:continue
        total=sum(r[3] for r in row['relations'])/2**30
        indexes=sum(r[2] for r in row['relations'])/2**30
        storage[variant]=(total-indexes,indexes)
    variants=[v for v in ['baseline','candidate','retained'] if v in storage]
    x=list(range(len(variants)))
    ax=axes[0,col]
    table=[storage[v][0] for v in variants];indexes=[storage[v][1] for v in variants]
    ax.bar(x,table,color='#8eacff',label='Table storage incl. TOAST/FSM/VM')
    ax.bar(x,indexes,bottom=table,color='#53dfb0',label='Indexes')
    for i,(t,ix) in enumerate(zip(table,indexes)):
        ax.text(i,t+ix,f'{t+ix:.2f}',ha='center',va='bottom',fontsize=10)
    ax.set_ylim(0,max((a+b for a,b in zip(table,indexes)),default=1)*1.18)
    ax.set_title(f'{size/1e6:g} million torrents',loc='left',fontsize=15,fontweight='bold',pad=16)
    ax.set_ylabel('Reduced-schema total · GiB')
    ax.set_xticks(x,[v.capitalize() for v in variants])
    ax.grid(axis='y',alpha=.15)
    ax=axes[1,col]
    writes={r['variant']:r for r in data['concurrent_writes'] if r['rows']==size and '-substring-' not in r['file'] and not r['file'].endswith('/raw-concurrent.jsonl')}
    ax.bar([i-.18 for i in x],[writes[v]['inserts_per_second'] for v in variants],width=.34,color='#53dfb0',label='Inserted torrents/s')
    ax.bar([i+.18 for i in x],[writes[v]['updates_per_second'] for v in variants],width=.34,color='#8eacff',label='Reobserved torrents/s')
    ax.set_xticks(x,[v.capitalize() for v in variants])
    ax.set_ylabel('Observed records per second')
    ax.set_ylim(0,max((max(writes[v]['inserts_per_second'],writes[v]['updates_per_second']) for v in variants),default=1)*1.3)
    ax.grid(axis='y',alpha=.15)
    for a in axes[:,col]:a.spines[['top','right']].set_visible(False)
axes[0,0].legend(loc='upper left',frameon=False,fontsize=8)
axes[1,0].legend(loc='upper left',frameon=False,fontsize=8)
fig.suptitle('Index costs: storage and mixed-write observations',x=.02,y=.985,ha='left',fontsize=18,fontweight='bold')
fig.text(.02,.035,'Same 25 SQL cases per main profile; each index set has one measured writer window. Query timeouts remain in the raw evidence.\n'
    'Baseline/candidate include a historical raw-TSV extension absent from the current backend; migration72 adds only two identity indexes.\n'
    'Synthetic insert/reobservation transactions and a reduced schema; these rates are not a production capacity forecast.',fontsize=9,color='#b7c5d8')
fig.tight_layout(rect=(.01,.13,.995,.94),h_pad=3,w_pad=3)
args.out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
fig.savefig(args.out,dpi=180)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Plot the separate raw-v2 predicate and prepared-identity experiments."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
from matplotlib.ticker import FuncFormatter

p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
p.add_argument('summary',type=Path)
p.add_argument('--out',type=Path,required=True)
args=p.parse_args()
data=json.loads(args.summary.read_text())
rows=[r for r in data['latencies'] if r['rows']==32000000 and not r['concurrent_writes']]
colors={'candidate':'#53dfb0','retained':'#ffbd73','resolved':'#c79bff'}
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family':'DejaVu Sans','font.size':10,'figure.facecolor':'#111722',
    'axes.facecolor':'#111722','axes.edgecolor':'#465267','text.color':'#edf1f7',
    'axes.labelcolor':'#d1dae8','xtick.color':'#b7c5d8','ytick.color':'#dbe4f1',
    'savefig.facecolor':'#111722'})
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(17,8.5))
profiles=[
 [('raw_substring_hot','literal','Substring · common'),('raw_substring_rare','literal','Substring · rare'),
  ('raw_substring_miss','literal','Substring · absent'),('raw_substring_wildcard','literal','Literal wildcard characters'),
  ('raw_v2_keyset','literal','Hash cursor · 101 rows')],
 [('identity_hot','auto','Hot canonical ID · automatic'),('identity_hot','force_generic_plan','Hot canonical ID · generic'),
  ('identity_episode_quality','auto','ID + episode + quality · automatic'),
  ('identity_episode_quality','force_generic_plan','ID + episode + quality · generic'),
  ('external_keyset','auto','Rare external ID · automatic'),('external_keyset','force_generic_plan','Rare external ID · generic'),
  ('external_hot','auto','Hot external alias · automatic'),('external_hot','force_generic_plan','Hot external alias · generic')]
]
for ax,cases,title in zip(axes,profiles,['Raw v2 operator/order profile','Prepared identities · server plan mode']):
    for ci,(case,mode,label) in enumerate(cases):
        for vi,variant in enumerate(colors):
            y=ci+(vi-1)*.2
            r=next((r for r in rows if r['case']==case and r['plan_mode']==mode and
                    r['variant']==variant and r['cache_state']=='warm'),None)
            if r:
                if r['errors']:
                    ax.scatter(5000,y,marker='>',s=45,color=colors[variant])
                elif r['samples']:
                    ax.plot([r['p50_ms'],r['p95_ms']],[y,y],color=colors[variant],lw=2)
                    ax.scatter([r['p50_ms'],r['p95_ms']],[y,y],s=[12,32],color=colors[variant])
            cold=next((r for r in rows if r['case']==case and r['plan_mode']==mode and
                       r['variant']==variant and r['cache_state']=='first_touch'),None)
            if cold:
                if cold['errors']:ax.scatter(5000,y+.07,marker='>',s=45,color=colors[variant])
                elif cold['samples']:ax.scatter(cold['p95_ms'],y+.07,s=55,facecolors='none',edgecolors=colors[variant],lw=1.5)
    ax.set_xscale('log');ax.set_xlim(.03,8500)
    ax.set_ylim(len(cases)-.5,-.6)
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(cases)),[v[2] for v in cases])
    ax.set_xticks([.1,1,10,100,1000,5000]);ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(lambda x,pos:f'{x:g}'))
    ax.set_xlabel('SQL retrieval · ms · logarithmic scale',labelpad=12)
    ax.set_title(title,loc='left',fontsize=14,fontweight='bold',pad=18)
    ax.grid(axis='x',alpha=.18);ax.tick_params(axis='y',length=0,pad=10)
    ax.spines[['top','right','left']].set_visible(False)
legend=[Line2D([0],[0],color=color,marker='o',lw=2,label=variant.capitalize()) for variant,color in colors.items()]
legend.append(Line2D([0],[0],marker='o',markerfacecolor='none',color='#cdd6e3',lw=0,label='Cold p95 · selected cases'))
fig.legend(handles=legend,loc='upper right',bbox_to_anchor=(.99,.99),ncol=4,frameon=False,fontsize=9)
fig.suptitle('32 million torrents: predicate and plan sensitivity',x=.02,y=.99,ha='left',fontsize=18,fontweight='bold')
fig.text(.02,.04,'Warm dots span p50 → p95. Hollow dots are cold p95. Triangles mark timeouts at the 5-second budget; partial successes remain in JSON.\n'
    'Resolved includes lookup + page + snapshot round trips. Reduced serving model · 6-CPU / 16-GiB database cap · 30 warm observations scheduled / 10 selected cold trials · no HTTP latency claim.',
    fontsize=9,color='#b7c5d8')
fig.tight_layout(rect=(.01,.12,.995,.91),w_pad=3)
args.out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
fig.savefig(args.out,dpi=180)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Join sampled container counters to suite stages without inventing coverage."""
import argparse
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import re
import statistics

p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
p.add_argument('summary',type=Path)
p.add_argument('resources',nargs='+',type=Path)
p.add_argument('--out',required=True,type=Path)
args=p.parse_args()
summary=json.loads(args.summary.read_text())
points=[]
for path in args.resources:
    with path.open() as source:
        for line in source:
            row=json.loads(line)
            row['file']=path.name
            points.append(row)
points.sort(key=lambda r:r['at'])

def bytes_value(text):
    match=re.fullmatch(r'([0-9.]+)\s*([A-Za-z]+)',text.strip())
    if not match:raise ValueError('unrecognized Docker memory unit')
    value,unit=match.groups()
    multiplier={'B':1,'KiB':2**10,'MiB':2**20,'GiB':2**30,'TiB':2**40,
                'kB':1000,'MB':1000**2,'GB':1000**3,'TB':1000**4}[unit]
    return float(value)*multiplier

def distribution(values):
    if not values:return None
    values=sorted(values)
    return {'samples':len(values),'min':values[0],'median':statistics.median(values),
            'p95':values[max(0,math.ceil(len(values)*.95)-1)],'max':values[-1]}

stages=[]
starts={}
for event in summary['stages']:
    key=(event['file'],event['stage'])
    if event['kind']=='stage_start':starts[key]=event['at']
    elif key in starts:
        start=starts.pop(key)
        selected=[r for r in points if start<=r['at']<=event['at']]
        stages.append({'file':event['file'],'stage':event['stage'],'start':start,'end':event['at'],
            'exit_code':event['exit_code'],'sample_count':len(selected),
            'cpu_percent_one_core_is_100':distribution([float(r['CPUPerc'].rstrip('%')) for r in selected]),

result={'format':1,'stages':stages,'resource_files':[p.name for p in args.resources],

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Summarize retained JSONL without discarding failed or skipped observations."""
import argparse
from collections import defaultdict
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
p.add_argument("inputs",nargs="+",type=Path)
p.add_argument("--out",required=True,type=Path)
args=p.parse_args()
files=[]
labels={}
for item in args.inputs:
    selected=sorted([*item.rglob('*.jsonl'),*item.rglob('*.jsonl.gz')]) if item.is_dir() else [item]
    files.extend(selected)
    for file in selected:
        labels[file]=str(Path(item.name)/file.relative_to(item)) if item.is_dir() else str(Path(item.parent.name)/item.name)
if not files:
    p.error("no raw JSONL files found")
if len(set(labels.values()))!=len(files):
    p.error("duplicate raw paths; select distinct qualified run folders")
groups=defaultdict(lambda:{"samples":[],"errors":0,"warmup_errors":0,"skipped":0,
                          "sqlstates":defaultdict(int),"counts":set(),"files":set()})
storage=[]
writes=[]
indexes=[]
reindex=[]
recovery=[]
correctness=[]
manifests=[]
complete=set()
inventory=[]
stages=[]
prepared=[]
plan_errors=[]


def key(row):
    return (row.get('rows'),row.get('variant'),row.get('cache_state'),row.get('updates',False),
            row.get('case'),row.get('plan_mode','literal'))


for file in files:
    label=labels[file]
    inventory.append({"name":label,"sha256":hashlib.sha256(file.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"bytes":file.stat().st_size})
    context={}
    prepared_variant=None
    reader=gzip.open if file.suffix=='.gz' else open
    with reader(file,'rt') as source:
        for line in source:
            row=json.loads(line)
            kind=row['kind']
            if kind=='run_start':
                context={k:row[k] for k in ['rows','variant','cache_state']}
                context['updates']=row['concurrent_updates']
            if kind in ['sample','sample_error','sample_skipped','warmup_error']:
                data={**context,**row}
                group=groups[key(data)]
                group['files'].add(label)
                if kind=='sample':
                    group['samples'].append(row['ms']);group['counts'].add(row['count'])
                elif kind=='sample_skipped':group['skipped']+=1
                else:
                    group['errors']+=1
                    group['warmup_errors']+=kind=='warmup_error'
                    group['sqlstates'][str(row.get('sqlstate'))]+=1
            elif kind=='storage':storage.append({"file":label,**row})
            elif kind=='update_summary' and row.get('batches'):
                batches=row['batches']
                seconds=row['seconds']
                writes.append({"file":label,"rows":row['rows'],"variant":row['variant'],"seconds":seconds,
                  "updated_torrents":row['updated_rows'],"inserted_torrents":row.get('inserted_rows',0),
                  "updates_per_second":row['updated_rows']/seconds,
                  "inserts_per_second":row.get('inserted_rows',0)/seconds,
                  "batch_errors":sum('error' in b for b in batches)})
            elif kind in ['index_change','index_build']:indexes.append({"file":label,**row})
            elif kind=='reindex':reindex.append({"file":label,**row})
            elif kind=='crash_recovery':recovery.append(row)
            elif kind in ['correctness','page_correctness','authority_check','raw_without_projection']:
                correctness.append({"file":label,**row})
            elif kind in ['manifest','prepared_manifest','supplement_manifest']:
                manifests.append(row)
                if kind=='prepared_manifest':prepared_variant=row['variant']
            elif kind=='prepared_counters':prepared.append({'file':label,'variant':prepared_variant,**row})
            elif kind=='plan_error':plan_errors.append({'file':label,
                **{k:context[k] for k in ['rows','variant'] if k in context},**row})
            elif kind=='scale_complete':complete.add(row['rows'])
            elif kind in ['stage_start','stage_end']:stages.append({'file':label,**row})


def quantile(values,q):
    return values[max(0,math.ceil(q*len(values))-1)] if values else None


latencies=[]
for k,group in groups.items():
    values=sorted(group['samples'])
    latencies.append({"rows":k[0],"variant":k[1],"cache_state":k[2],"concurrent_writes":k[3],"case":k[4],"plan_mode":k[5],
      "samples":len(values),"errors":group['errors'],"skipped":group['skipped'],"p50_ms":quantile(values,.5),
      "warmup_errors":group['warmup_errors'],"sqlstates":dict(group['sqlstates']),
      "p95_ms":quantile(values,.95),"p99_ms":quantile(values,.99),"min_ms":min(values) if values else None,
      "max_ms":max(values) if values else None,"result_counts":sorted(group['counts']),"files":sorted(group['files'])})
result={"format":1,"quantile_method":"nearest rank; successes only; failures/skips retained separately",
  "completed_scales":sorted(complete),"manifests":manifests,"latencies":latencies,
  "storage":storage,"concurrent_writes":writes,"index_operations":indexes,"reindex":reindex,"recovery":recovery,
  "correctness":correctness,"stages":stages,"raw_files":inventory,
  "prepared_plan_counters":prepared,
  "plan_errors":plan_errors,
  "limits":["SQL microbenchmark; no HTTP serialization or complete production schema",
            "20-byte synthetic hashes; stated skew and file distribution",
            "30 warm and 10 selected cold samples give limited p99 resolution",
            "cold evicts only stopped database files; device caches remain uncontrolled",
            "timeout groups must not be described using successful latency quantiles alone"]}
args.out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
args.out.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({"completed_scales":result['completed_scales'],"latency_groups":len(latencies),
                  "groups_with_errors":sum(x['errors']>0 for x in latencies),"raw_files":len(inventory)}))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Replay saved page digests against an independent synthetic-population oracle."""
import argparse
from collections import Counter
from functools import lru_cache
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
p.add_argument('inputs',nargs='+',type=Path)
p.add_argument('--out',required=True,type=Path)
args=p.parse_args()
rare={'identity_rare','external_correlated','external_identifier','external_keyset',
      'text_rare','raw_text_rare','raw_substring_rare'}
hot={'external_hot','external_hot_or_missing','external_hot_or_canonical','identity_episode_quality'}


@lru_cache(None)
def expected(size,case):
    accepted=case in {'identity_rare','external_correlated','external_identifier','external_keyset'} or case in hot
    candidates=[]
    if case in rare:
        first=((123456-1000)*pow(48271,-1,1000003))%1000003
        numbers=range(first or 1000003,size+1,1000003)
    else:
        numbers=range(20,size+1,20)
    for n in numbers:
        if case in rare and n%20==0:continue
        trusted=(n//20)%10<7
        if accepted and not trusted:continue
        if n%199==0 or n%211==0:continue
        if case=='identity_episode_quality' and not (n%8==0 and (n%11==0 or n%24==4)):continue
        h=hashlib.md5(('synthetic-'+str(n)).encode()).hexdigest()+hashlib.md5(('tail-'+str(n)).encode()).hexdigest()[:8]
        family=123456 if case in rare else 1
        identifier=h if case.startswith('raw_') else h+(':'+('movie' if family%3==0 else 'tv_show')+':synthetic:'+str(family) if trusted else ':?:?:?')
        candidates.append((n%100000,h,identifier))
    ordered=sorted(candidates,key=lambda r:r[1]) if case.startswith('raw_') else sorted(candidates,reverse=True)
    page=[(identifier,h) for _,h,identifier in ordered[:101 if case=='raw_substring_rare' else 100]]
    return hashlib.sha256(repr(page).encode()).hexdigest(),len(page)


checked=Counter();files=0
for root in args.inputs:
    for path in sorted(root.rglob('*.jsonl')):
        context={};used=False
        for line in path.open():
            row=json.loads(line)
            if row['kind']=='run_start':
                context={'rows':row['rows'],'updates':row['concurrent_updates']}
            if row['kind']!='sample':continue
            row={**context,**row}
            case=row['case']
            if row.get('updates') or case not in rare|hot:continue
            digest,count=expected(row['rows'],case)
            if (row['digest'],row['count'])!=(digest,count):
                raise SystemExit('saved page differs from complete independent oracle: '+path.name+' / '+case)
            checked[case]+=1;used=True
        files+=used
result={'format':1,'verified_sample_digests':sum(checked.values()),'files_with_verified_samples':files,
        'by_case':dict(sorted(checked.items())),'failures':0,
        'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        'scope':'non-concurrent saved rare, hot-alias and combined-filter pages; independent modular population and hash/order oracle'}
args.out.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Disposable SQL-plan benchmark. Never connects to the application database.

Install requirements.txt in a venv. See README.md for the complete protocol.
The database must be named dh_waypoint_bench_*. Every raw observation is JSONL.
"""
import argparse
import concurrent.futures
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import random
import shutil
import threading
import time

import psycopg

SCHEMA = "catalogue_bench"
IDENTITY = "CASE WHEN n % 20 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 1000 + ((n * 48271) % 1000003) END"
TRUSTED = "((n / 20) % 10 < 7)"
TYPE = "CASE WHEN family % 3 = 0 THEN 'movie' ELSE 'tv_show' END"
ORDER = "published_at DESC, info_hash DESC, id DESC"

DDL = """
CREATE SCHEMA catalogue_bench;
SET search_path = catalogue_bench;
CREATE TABLE sentinel (format text PRIMARY KEY);
INSERT INTO sentinel VALUES ('synthetic-catalogue-v1');
CREATE TABLE torrents (
 n bigint UNIQUE NOT NULL, info_hash bytea PRIMARY KEY, name text NOT NULL,
 size bigint NOT NULL, private boolean NOT NULL, files_count int NOT NULL,
 tsv tsvector GENERATED ALWAYS AS (to_tsvector('simple',name)) STORED,
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE content (
 type text NOT NULL, source text NOT NULL, id text NOT NULL, title text NOT NULL,
 adult boolean NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(type,source,id)
);
CREATE TABLE content_attributes (
 content_type text NOT NULL, content_source text NOT NULL, content_id text NOT NULL,
 source text NOT NULL, key text NOT NULL, value text NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(content_type,content_source,content_id,source,key)
);
CREATE TABLE torrent_contents (
 id text GENERATED ALWAYS AS (encode(info_hash,'hex') || ':' ||
   coalesce(content_type,'?') || ':' || coalesce(content_source,'?') || ':' ||
   coalesce(content_id,'?')) STORED PRIMARY KEY,
 info_hash bytea NOT NULL REFERENCES torrents(info_hash),
 content_type text, content_source text, content_id text,
 search_string text NOT NULL,
 tsv tsvector GENERATED ALWAYS AS (to_tsvector('simple',search_string)) STORED,
 episodes jsonb, video_resolution text, seeders bigint,
 published_at timestamptz NOT NULL, updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
 FOREIGN KEY(content_type,content_source,content_id) REFERENCES content(type,source,id)
);
CREATE TABLE torrent_files (
 info_hash bytea NOT NULL REFERENCES torrents(info_hash), "index" int NOT NULL,
 path text NOT NULL, size bigint NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(info_hash,"index")
);
CREATE TABLE annotations (
 info_hash bytea PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES torrents(info_hash), plugin_id text NOT NULL,
 source_revision int NOT NULL, current_revision int NOT NULL,
 confidence real NOT NULL, verification text NOT NULL,
 proposed_type text NOT NULL, proposed_id text NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE quarantined (info_hash bytea PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES torrents(info_hash));
"""

# These model existing serving-query indexes, not every historical schema index.
BASE_INDEXES = [
 "CREATE INDEX raw_tsv_btree ON torrents(tsv)",
 "CREATE INDEX tc_hash ON torrent_contents(info_hash)",
 "CREATE INDEX tc_type ON torrent_contents(content_type)",
 "CREATE INDEX tc_source_id ON torrent_contents(content_source,content_id)",
 "CREATE INDEX tc_published ON torrent_contents(published_at)",
 "CREATE INDEX tc_tsv ON torrent_contents USING gin(tsv)",
 "CREATE INDEX tc_episodes_btree ON torrent_contents(episodes)",
 "CREATE INDEX tc_group ON torrent_contents(content_type,content_source,content_id,"
 "(coalesce(seeders,-1)) DESC,info_hash) WHERE content_id IS NOT NULL",
]
CANDIDATE_INDEXES = [
 "CREATE INDEX raw_tsv_gin ON torrents USING gin(tsv)",
 "CREATE INDEX tc_type_page ON torrent_contents(content_type,published_at DESC,info_hash DESC,id DESC)",
 "CREATE INDEX tc_page ON torrent_contents(published_at DESC,info_hash DESC,id DESC)",
 "CREATE INDEX tc_episodes_gin ON torrent_contents USING gin(episodes)",
 "CREATE INDEX ca_external ON content_attributes(source,value,content_type,content_source,content_id) WHERE key='id'",
]
IDENTITY_PAGE_INDEX = """CREATE INDEX tc_identity_page ON torrent_contents(
 content_type,content_source,content_id,published_at DESC,info_hash DESC,id DESC)
 WHERE content_id IS NOT NULL"""
RAW_SUBSTRING_INDEX = "CREATE INDEX raw_name_trgm ON torrents USING gin(name public.gin_trgm_ops)"

# Current catalogue authority is read separately from attributed plugin proposals.
ELIGIBLE = """EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM torrents t WHERE t.info_hash=tc.info_hash AND NOT t.private)
 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM quarantined q WHERE q.info_hash=tc.info_hash)
 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM torrent_contents serving_tc LEFT JOIN content c
 ON (c.type,c.source,c.id)=(serving_tc.content_type,serving_tc.content_source,serving_tc.content_id)
 WHERE serving_tc.info_hash=tc.info_hash AND (serving_tc.content_type='xxx' OR c.adult IS TRUE))"""


def raw_serving_policy():
    # Actual raw serving checks its own private field directly. Preserve the
    # original 25-case reduced-policy experiment, and use this for v2 probes.
    return ELIGIBLE.replace('=tc.info_hash','=raw.info_hash').replace(
        'EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM torrents t WHERE t.info_hash=raw.info_hash AND NOT t.private)',
        'NOT raw.private',1)


def emit(path, obj):
    obj = {"at": time.time(), **obj}
    with Path(path).open("a") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, default=str) + "\n")


def connect(dsn):
    conn = psycopg.connect(dsn, autocommit=True)
    if not conn.execute("SELECT current_database()").fetchone()[0].startswith("dh_waypoint_bench_"):
        conn.close()
        raise RuntimeError("refusing database without dh_waypoint_bench_ prefix")
    conn.execute("SET search_path=catalogue_bench")
    conn.execute("SET statement_timeout='5s'")
    return conn


def timed(conn, sql, params=None):
    start = time.perf_counter()
    result = conn.execute(sql, params).fetchall() if params is not None else conn.execute(sql).fetchall()
    return (time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000, result


def bound(conn, sql, params):
    # psycopg's parameter format reserves %, including SQL's modulo operator.
    return conn.execute(sql.replace("%", "%%").replace("%%s", "%s"), params)


def preflight(conn, args):
    # This path must be on the database volume's filesystem, not a cloud mount.
    disk = shutil.disk_usage(args.disk_path)
    info = {"kind": "preflight", "free_bytes": disk.free,
            "source_sha256":hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            "required_free_bytes": args.min_free_gib * 2**30,
            "cpu_count": os.cpu_count(), "postgres": conn.execute("SELECT version()").fetchone()[0],
            "settings": dict(conn.execute("SELECT name,setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name = ANY(%s)",
                          (["shared_buffers", "work_mem", "maintenance_work_mem", "max_parallel_workers_per_gather",
                            "max_connections", "fsync", "synchronous_commit", "full_page_writes"],)).fetchall())}
    emit(args.out, info)
    if disk.free < args.min_free_gib * 2**30:
        raise RuntimeError("insufficient disk reserve")


def seed(conn, args):
    if not args.disposable:
        raise RuntimeError("seed requires --disposable")
    preflight(conn, args)
    conn.execute("SET statement_timeout=0")
    exists = conn.execute("SELECT to_regclass('catalogue_bench.sentinel')").fetchone()[0]
    if not exists:
        conn.execute(DDL)
    if conn.execute("SELECT format FROM sentinel").fetchall() != [("synthetic-catalogue-v1",)]:
        raise RuntimeError("unrecognized fixture")
    # Permit an earlier fixture to acquire the same raw FTS column as core.
    conn.execute("ALTER TABLE torrents ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS tsv tsvector GENERATED ALWAYS AS (to_tsvector('simple',name)) STORED")
    # Universe independent of requested scale; identities remain stable as it grows.
    conn.execute("""INSERT INTO content SELECT CASE WHEN n%3=0 THEN 'movie' ELSE 'tv_show' END,
      'synthetic',n::text,'Synthetic title'||n,(n%101=0)
      FROM generate_series(1,1001003) n ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING""")
    conn.execute("""INSERT INTO content_attributes SELECT type,source,id,'imdb','id','tt'||id
      FROM content ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING""")
    first = conn.execute("SELECT coalesce(max(n),0)+1 FROM torrents").fetchone()[0]
    count=conn.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM torrents").fetchone()[0]
    if count != first-1:
        raise RuntimeError("incomplete previous parallel seed: recreate disposable fixture")
    bulk=args.rows-count>=1000000 and not args.keep_seed_indexes
    emit(args.out,{"kind":"seed_policy","rows_before":count,"rows_target":args.rows,
                   "workers":args.workers,"bulk_secondary_rebuild":bulk})
    if bulk:
        # Population construction is separate from steady ingestion. Keep all
        # PK/unique/FK constraints, and rebuild only our query indexes afterward.
        for sql in BASE_INDEXES:
            name=sql.split()[2]
            conn.execute('DROP INDEX IF EXISTS '+name)
            emit(args.out,{"kind":"bulk_index_drop","index":name})
    ranges=[(start,min(start+args.batch-1,args.rows)) for start in range(first,args.rows+1,args.batch)]
    def worker(bounds):
        with connect(args.dsn) as batch_conn:
            batch_conn.execute("SET statement_timeout=0")
            seed_range(batch_conn,args,*bounds)
    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=args.workers) as executor:
        list(executor.map(worker,ranges))
    for sql in BASE_INDEXES:
        sql = sql.replace("CREATE INDEX ","CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ")
        start = time.perf_counter()
        conn.execute(sql)
        emit(args.out,{"kind":"index_build","variant":"baseline","sql":sql,"seconds":time.perf_counter()-start})
    conn.execute("VACUUM (ANALYZE)")
    storage(conn,args)


def seed_range(conn,args,start,end):
    if shutil.disk_usage(args.disk_path).free < args.min_free_gib * 2**30:
        raise RuntimeError("disk reserve reached during seed")
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    with conn.transaction():
        bound(conn, f"""INSERT INTO torrents(n,info_hash,name,size,private,files_count,created_at)
          SELECT n,decode(md5('synthetic-'||n)||substr(md5('tail-'||n),1,8),'hex'),
            'Synthetic title'||family||' release'||n%4096||' season'||n%10||
            ' episode'||n%24||' resolution'||CASE WHEN n%8=0 THEN 2160 ELSE 1080 END||' group'||n%127,
            (1+n%64)*1073741824::bigint,n%199=0,
            CASE WHEN n%100=0 THEN 100 WHEN n%20=0 THEN 10 ELSE 1 END,
            '2025-01-01'::timestamptz+(n%100000)*interval '1 second'
          FROM (SELECT n,{IDENTITY} family FROM generate_series(%s::bigint,%s::bigint) n) x""", (start,end))
        bound(conn, f"""INSERT INTO torrent_contents
          (info_hash,content_type,content_source,content_id,search_string,episodes,video_resolution,
           seeders,published_at,updated_at)
          SELECT info_hash,CASE WHEN {TRUSTED} THEN {TYPE} END,
            CASE WHEN {TRUSTED} THEN 'synthetic' END,
            CASE WHEN {TRUSTED} THEN family::text END,name,
            jsonb_build_object((n%10)::text,CASE WHEN n%11=0 THEN '{{}}'::jsonb
              ELSE jsonb_build_object((n%24)::text,'{{}}'::jsonb) END),
            CASE WHEN n%8=0 THEN '2160p' ELSE '1080p' END,
            CASE WHEN n%7=0 THEN NULL ELSE n%500 END,created_at,created_at
          FROM (SELECT *,{IDENTITY} family FROM torrents WHERE n BETWEEN %s AND %s) x""",(start,end))
        bound(conn, f"""INSERT INTO annotations SELECT info_hash,'synthetic/classifier',
          CASE WHEN (n/20)%10=7 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,2,
          CASE WHEN (n/20)%10=8 THEN 0.4 ELSE 0.99 END,
          CASE WHEN {TRUSTED} THEN 'accepted' ELSE 'proposed' END,{TYPE},family::text
          FROM (SELECT *,{IDENTITY} family FROM torrents WHERE n BETWEEN %s AND %s) x
          WHERE (n/20)%10<>9""",(start,end))
        conn.execute("""INSERT INTO torrent_files SELECT info_hash,i,
          'synthetic/'||n||'/file-'||i||'.mkv',size/files_count
          FROM torrents CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(1,files_count) i WHERE n BETWEEN %s AND %s""",(start,end))
        bound(conn,"INSERT INTO quarantined SELECT info_hash FROM torrents WHERE n BETWEEN %s AND %s AND n%211=0",(start,end))
    emit(args.out,{"kind":"seed_batch","start":start,"end":end,"seconds":time.perf_counter()-t0})


def storage(conn,args):
    conn.execute("SET statement_timeout='180s'")
    emit(args.out,{"kind":"storage","rows":conn.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM torrents").fetchone()[0],
                  "files":conn.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM torrent_files").fetchone()[0],
                  "relations":conn.execute("""SELECT relname,pg_relation_size(oid),pg_indexes_size(oid),
                    pg_total_relation_size(oid) FROM pg_class WHERE relnamespace='catalogue_bench'::regnamespace
                    AND relkind='r' ORDER BY relname""").fetchall(),
                  "indexes":conn.execute("""SELECT indexrelname,pg_relation_size(indexrelid)
                    FROM pg_stat_user_indexes WHERE schemaname='catalogue_bench' ORDER BY indexrelname""").fetchall()})
    conn.execute("SET statement_timeout='5s'")


def cases(rows):
    fields = "tc.id,tc.info_hash"
    def page(predicate, suffix="LIMIT 100"):
        return f"SELECT {fields} FROM torrent_contents tc WHERE ({predicate}) AND {ELIGIBLE} ORDER BY {ORDER} {suffix}"
    identity = "tc.content_type='tv_show' AND tc.content_source='synthetic' AND tc.content_id='1'"
    text = "tc.tsv @@ 'title1'::tsquery"
    queries = {
      "hash":page("tc.info_hash=decode(md5('synthetic-1234')||substr(md5('tail-1234'),1,8),'hex')"),
      "identity_hot":page(identity),
      "identity_rare":page("tc.content_type='movie' AND tc.content_source='synthetic' AND tc.content_id='123456'"),
      "identity_join":f"SELECT {fields} FROM torrent_contents tc JOIN content c ON (c.type,c.source,c.id)="
        f"(tc.content_type,tc.content_source,tc.content_id) WHERE c.type='tv_show' AND c.source='synthetic' AND c.id='1' AND {ELIGIBLE} ORDER BY {ORDER} LIMIT 100",
      "external_correlated":page("EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM content_attributes ca WHERE "
        "(ca.content_type,ca.content_source,ca.content_id)=(tc.content_type,tc.content_source,tc.content_id) "
        "AND ca.source='imdb' AND ca.value='tt123456')"),
      "external_identifier":page("EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM content_attributes ca WHERE "
        "(ca.content_type,ca.content_source,ca.content_id)=(tc.content_type,tc.content_source,tc.content_id) "
        "AND ca.source='imdb' AND ca.key='id' AND ca.value='tt123456')"),
      "external_keyset":page("(tc.content_type,tc.content_source,tc.content_id) IN ("
        "VALUES ('movie','imdb','tt123456') UNION ALL SELECT content_type,content_source,content_id "
        "FROM content_attributes WHERE content_type='movie' AND source='imdb' AND key='id' AND value='tt123456')"),
      "text_hot":page(text),
      "text_rare":page("tc.tsv @@ 'title123456'::tsquery"),
      "text_miss":page("tc.tsv @@ 'unfindabletoken'::tsquery"),
      "type_browse":page("tc.content_type='movie'"),
      "quality":page("tc.content_type='tv_show' AND tc.video_resolution='2160p'"),
      "season_current":page("jsonb_exists(tc.episodes,'3')"),
      "season_indexable":page("tc.episodes @> '{\"3\":{}}'::jsonb"),
      "episode_current":page("(tc.episodes #> '{3}'='{}'::jsonb OR tc.episodes #> '{3}' @> '{\"3\":{}}'::jsonb)"),
      "episode_indexable":page("tc.episodes @> '{\"3\":{\"3\":{}}}'::jsonb OR "
        "(tc.episodes @> '{\"3\":{}}'::jsonb AND tc.episodes #> '{3}'='{}'::jsonb)"),
      "offset":page("true",f"OFFSET {min(rows//2,1000000)} LIMIT 100"),
      # Cursor anchor is an actual deterministic tuple, not a timestamp forecast.
      "keyset":page("(tc.published_at,tc.info_hash,tc.id)<CURSOR_ANCHOR"),
      "grouped":f"SELECT DISTINCT ON (tc.content_type,tc.content_source,tc.content_id) {fields} "
        f"FROM torrent_contents tc WHERE tc.content_id IS NOT NULL AND {ELIGIBLE} "
        "ORDER BY tc.content_type,tc.content_source,tc.content_id,coalesce(tc.seeders,-1) DESC,tc.info_hash LIMIT 100",
      # Same eligible textual set as raw text; never certify fallback as a known identity.
      "enriched_with_fallback":f"SELECT id,info_hash FROM ("
        f"SELECT tc.id,tc.info_hash,tc.published_at FROM torrent_contents tc WHERE ({identity}) AND {ELIGIBLE} "
        "UNION ALL SELECT tc.id,tc.info_hash,tc.published_at FROM torrent_contents tc "
        f"WHERE tc.content_id IS NULL AND ({text}) AND {ELIGIBLE}) all_candidates ORDER BY {ORDER} LIMIT 100",
    }
    queries['enriched_bounded_fallback']=f"SELECT id,info_hash FROM (("
    queries['enriched_bounded_fallback']+=f"SELECT tc.id,tc.info_hash,tc.published_at FROM torrent_contents tc WHERE ({identity}) AND {ELIGIBLE} ORDER BY {ORDER} LIMIT 100) "
    queries['enriched_bounded_fallback']+="UNION ALL (SELECT tc.id,tc.info_hash,tc.published_at FROM torrent_contents tc "
    queries['enriched_bounded_fallback']+=f"WHERE tc.content_id IS NULL AND ({text}) AND {ELIGIBLE} ORDER BY {ORDER} LIMIT 100)) all_candidates ORDER BY {ORDER} LIMIT 100"
    raw_policy=ELIGIBLE.replace('=tc.info_hash','=raw.info_hash')
    def raw_page(predicate,policy=raw_policy):
        return f"SELECT encode(raw.info_hash,'hex') AS id,raw.info_hash FROM torrents raw WHERE ({predicate}) AND {policy} ORDER BY raw.info_hash LIMIT 100"
    queries['raw_text_hot']=raw_page("raw.tsv @@ 'title1'::tsquery")
    queries['raw_text_rare']=raw_page("raw.tsv @@ 'title123456'::tsquery")
    queries['raw_text_miss']=raw_page("raw.tsv @@ 'unfindabletoken'::tsquery")
    queries['raw_keyset']=raw_page("raw.info_hash>decode('8000000000000000000000000000000000000000','hex')")
    # REST v2 uses escaped literal ILIKE, not TSV syntax. Keep these separate
    # from the raw full-text alternative and fetch limit+1 as the API does.
    for name,term in {'hot':'title1','rare':'title123456 ',
                      'miss':'unfindabletoken','wildcard':'title_%'}.items():
        escaped=term.replace('\\','\\\\').replace('%','\\%').replace('_','\\_')
        literal=psycopg.sql.Literal('%'+escaped+'%').as_string()
        queries['raw_substring_'+name]=raw_page('raw.name ILIKE '+literal,raw_serving_policy()).replace('LIMIT 100','LIMIT 101')
    queries['raw_v2_keyset']=raw_page("raw.info_hash>decode('8000000000000000000000000000000000000000','hex')",
                                     raw_serving_policy()).replace('LIMIT 100','LIMIT 101')
    return queries


def digest(result):
    return hashlib.sha256(repr([(r[0],bytes(r[1]).hex()) for r in result]).encode()).hexdigest()


def verify_page(conn,args,name,result):
    """An independent mathematical oracle; does not reuse ELIGIBLE SQL."""
    hashes=[bytes(r[1]) for r in result]
    if len(set(r[0] for r in result))!=len(result):
        raise RuntimeError(f"duplicate row in {name}")
    observations=conn.execute("SELECT info_hash,n FROM torrents WHERE info_hash=ANY(%s)",(hashes,)).fetchall()
    by_hash={bytes(h):n for h,n in observations}
    for identifier,hash_value in result:
        n=by_hash[bytes(hash_value)]
        family=1 if n%20==0 else 1000+(n*48271)%1000003
        trusted=(n//20)%10<7
        if n%199==0 or n%211==0 or (trusted and family%101==0):
            raise RuntimeError(f"ineligible result from {name}")
        if name in ['identity_hot','identity_join','identity_episode_quality','external_hot'] and not (family==1 and trusted):
            raise RuntimeError(f"wrong canonical identity from {name}")
        if name=='identity_episode_quality' and not (n%8==0 and n%10==0 and (n%11==0 or n%24==4)):
            raise RuntimeError('wrong canonical episode/quality candidate')
        if name in ['identity_rare','external_correlated','external_identifier','external_keyset'] and not (family==123456 and trusted):
            raise RuntimeError(f"wrong rare or external identity from {name}")
        if name in ['text_hot','raw_text_hot','enriched_with_fallback','enriched_bounded_fallback'] and family!=1:
            raise RuntimeError(f"wrong text candidate from {name}")
        if name in ['text_rare','raw_text_rare'] and family!=123456:
            raise RuntimeError("wrong rare text candidate")
        if name=='type_browse' and not (trusted and family%3==0):
            raise RuntimeError("wrong movie type")
        if name=='quality' and not (trusted and family%3!=0 and n%8==0):
            raise RuntimeError("wrong TV quality")
        if name.startswith('season_') and n%10!=3:
            raise RuntimeError("wrong season")
        if name.startswith('episode_') and not (n%10==3 and (n%11==0 or n%24==3)):
            raise RuntimeError("wrong episode or pack")
    if name in ['text_miss','raw_text_miss'] and result:
        raise RuntimeError("miss returned results")
    if name=='raw_v2_keyset' and (hashes!=sorted(hashes) or any(h<=bytes.fromhex('80'+'00'*19) for h in hashes)):
        raise RuntimeError('wrong raw v2 cursor ordering or boundary')
    if name.startswith('raw_substring_'):
        if name in ['raw_substring_miss','raw_substring_wildcard'] and result:
            raise RuntimeError('literal substring miss returned results')
        for _,hash_value in result:
            n=by_hash[bytes(hash_value)]
            family=1 if n%20==0 else 1000+(n*48271)%1000003
            if name=='raw_substring_hot' and 'title1' not in 'title'+str(family):
                raise RuntimeError('wrong literal substring candidate')
            if name=='raw_substring_rare' and family!=123456:
                raise RuntimeError('wrong rare literal substring candidate')
    if not getattr(args,'updates',False) and name in ['identity_rare','external_correlated','external_identifier','external_keyset',
                'text_rare','raw_text_rare','raw_substring_rare']:
        # Invert the fixture's modular identity assignment. This independently
        # checks completeness and ordering, including an incorrectly empty page.
        rows=conn.execute('SELECT max(n) FROM torrents').fetchone()[0]
        first=((123456-1000)*pow(48271,-1,1000003))%1000003
        expected=[]
        for n in range(first or 1000003,rows+1,1000003):
            trusted=(n//20)%10<7
            if n%20==0 or n%199==0 or n%211==0:
                continue
            if name in ['identity_rare','external_correlated','external_identifier','external_keyset'] and not trusted:
                continue
            h=bytes.fromhex(hashlib.md5(('synthetic-'+str(n)).encode()).hexdigest()+
                            hashlib.md5(('tail-'+str(n)).encode()).hexdigest()[:8])
            expected.append((n%100000,h))
        expected_hashes=([h for _,h in sorted(expected,key=lambda r:r[1])] if name.startswith('raw_')
                         else [h for _,h in sorted(expected,reverse=True)])
        if hashes!=expected_hashes[:101 if name=='raw_substring_rare' else 100]:
            raise RuntimeError('rare identity/text page differs from independent complete oracle: '+name)
    if name=='identity_episode_quality':
        rows=conn.execute('SELECT max(n) FROM torrents').fetchone()[0]
        expected=[]
        for n in range(20,rows+1,20):
            if (n//20)%10>=7 or n%199==0 or n%211==0 or n%8!=0 or not (n%11==0 or n%24==4):
                continue
            h=bytes.fromhex(hashlib.md5(('synthetic-'+str(n)).encode()).hexdigest()+
                            hashlib.md5(('tail-'+str(n)).encode()).hexdigest()[:8])
            expected.append((n%100000,h))
        if hashes!=[h for _,h in sorted(expected,reverse=True)[:100]]:
            raise RuntimeError('combined identity/episode/quality page differs from complete oracle')
    if name=='external_hot':
        rows=conn.execute('SELECT max(n) FROM torrents').fetchone()[0]
        expected=[]
        # Enumerate timestamp groups newest first; finish the group that fills
        # the page so its hash ties are independently ordered too.
        for stamp in range(min(rows,99999),-1,-1):
            if stamp%20 or (stamp//20)%10>=7:continue
            for n in range(stamp or 100000,rows+1,100000):
                if n%199==0 or n%211==0:continue
                h=bytes.fromhex(hashlib.md5(('synthetic-'+str(n)).encode()).hexdigest()+
                                hashlib.md5(('tail-'+str(n)).encode()).hexdigest()[:8])
                expected.append((stamp,h))
            if len(expected)>=100:break
        if hashes!=[h for _,h in sorted(expected,reverse=True)[:100]]:
            raise RuntimeError('hot external-ID page differs from independent complete oracle')
    emit(args.out,{"kind":"page_correctness","case":name,"checked":len(result),"failures":0})


def correctness(conn,args,queries):
    def differences(left,right):
        # Each complete result is evaluated once, then compared both ways.
        # This does not alter or time the serving-query implementation.
        return f"WITH a AS MATERIALIZED ({left}), b AS MATERIALIZED ({right}) "+\
            "SELECT count(*) FROM ((SELECT * FROM a EXCEPT SELECT * FROM b) "+\
            "UNION ALL (SELECT * FROM b EXCEPT SELECT * FROM a)) differences"
    pairs=[("identity_hot","identity_join"),("external_correlated","external_identifier"),
           ("external_identifier","external_keyset"),("season_current","season_indexable"),
           ("episode_current","episode_indexable"),("text_hot","enriched_with_fallback")]
    # Both directions and complete sets, independent of LIMIT/page representative.
    for left,right in pairs:
        def full(sql):
            return sql.rsplit(" ORDER BY ",1)[0]
        query=differences(full(queries[left]),full(queries[right]))
        start=time.perf_counter()
        conn.execute("SET statement_timeout='600s'")
        delta=conn.execute(query).fetchone()[0]
        emit(args.out,{"kind":"correctness","left":left,"right":right,"differences":delta,
                       "seconds":time.perf_counter()-start})
        if delta:
            raise RuntimeError(f"result mismatch {left}/{right}: {delta}")
    raw=conn.execute(queries['text_hot']).fetchall()
    bounded=conn.execute(queries['enriched_bounded_fallback']).fetchall()
    if raw!=bounded:
        raise RuntimeError("bounded fallback changed page or ordering")
    emit(args.out,{"kind":"correctness","left":"text_hot","right":"enriched_bounded_fallback",
                   "page_equal":True,"differences":0})
    left=queries['text_hot'].rsplit(' ORDER BY ',1)[0]
    right=queries['raw_text_hot'].rsplit(' ORDER BY ',1)[0]
    delta=conn.execute(differences(f'SELECT info_hash FROM ({left}) x',
                                  f'SELECT info_hash FROM ({right}) y')).fetchone()[0]
    emit(args.out,{"kind":"correctness","left":"content_name_fts","right":"raw_torrent_name_fts","differences":delta})
    if delta:
        raise RuntimeError("raw and content name indexes disagree")
    if args.rows>=198:
        # Temporarily remove one unclassified projection. Raw catalogue search
        # must still work without waiting for any processor to create that row.
        raw_policy=ELIGIBLE.replace('=tc.info_hash','=raw.info_hash')
        with conn.transaction():
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM torrent_contents WHERE info_hash=(SELECT info_hash FROM torrents WHERE n=198)")
            visible=conn.execute(f"SELECT count(*) FROM torrents raw WHERE raw.n=198 AND {raw_policy}").fetchone()[0]
            if visible!=1:
                raise RuntimeError("raw record lost without content projection")
            raise psycopg.Rollback()
        emit(args.out,{"kind":"raw_without_projection","visible":1})
    # Correctness is assessed while ingestion is stopped, on a stable snapshot.
    unsafe=conn.execute("""SELECT count(*) FROM torrent_contents tc JOIN annotations a USING(info_hash)
      WHERE tc.content_id IS NOT NULL AND (a.source_revision<>a.current_revision OR a.confidence<0.9
      OR a.verification<>'accepted')""").fetchone()[0]
    emit(args.out,{"kind":"authority_check","unsafe_promotions":unsafe})
    if unsafe:
        raise RuntimeError("uncertain or stale annotation promoted")
    conn.execute("SET statement_timeout='5s'")


def writer(args,stop,counter):
    with connect(args.dsn) as conn:
        rng=random.Random(9844)
        maximum=conn.execute("SELECT max(n) FROM torrents").fetchone()[0]
        next_new=maximum+1
        batches=0
        while not stop.is_set():
            lower=rng.randrange(1,max(2,maximum-100))
            start=time.perf_counter()
            try:
                if args.ingest and batches%5==0:
                    seed_range(conn,args,next_new,next_new+99)
                    counter.append({"inserted_rows":100,"ms":(time.perf_counter()-start)*1000})
                    next_new+=100
                    start=time.perf_counter()
                # Crawl re-observation plus changed source metadata. Fenced within fixture.
                with conn.transaction():
                    conn.execute("UPDATE torrents SET created_at=created_at WHERE n BETWEEN %s AND %s",(lower,lower+99))
                    result=conn.execute("""UPDATE torrent_contents SET updated_at=clock_timestamp(),
                      seeders=coalesce(seeders,0)+1 WHERE info_hash IN
                      (SELECT info_hash FROM torrents WHERE n BETWEEN %s AND %s)""",(lower,lower+99))
                counter.append({"rows":result.rowcount,"ms":(time.perf_counter()-start)*1000})
                batches+=1
            except psycopg.Error as err:
                counter.append({"error":err.sqlstate})
                stop.set()


def run(conn,args):
    preflight(conn,args)
    conn.execute("SET statement_timeout='180s'")
    rows=(args.rows if args.cache_state=="first_touch" else conn.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM torrents").fetchone()[0])
    queries=cases(rows)
    if args.cases:
        wanted=set(args.cases.split(','))
        if wanted-queries.keys():raise RuntimeError('unknown query case: '+','.join(sorted(wanted-queries.keys())))
        queries={k:v for k,v in queries.items() if k in wanted}
    else:
        # Preserve the original 25-case mix across all three main scales.
        # The subsequently merged v2 API gets an explicit supplemental profile.
        queries={k:v for k,v in queries.items() if not k.startswith(('raw_substring_','raw_v2_'))}
    # Resolve cursor outside measurement; fetching an anchor is not part of the keyset request.
    if "keyset" in queries:
        anchor_start=time.perf_counter()
        anchor=conn.execute(f"SELECT published_at,info_hash,id FROM torrent_contents ORDER BY {ORDER} "
                            f"OFFSET {min(rows//2,1000000)} LIMIT 1").fetchone()
        literal=psycopg.sql.SQL("({},{},{})").format(*(psycopg.sql.Literal(x) for x in anchor)).as_string(conn)
        queries['keyset']=queries['keyset'].replace('CURSOR_ANCHOR',literal)
        emit(args.out,{"kind":"anchor_setup","rows":rows,"seconds":time.perf_counter()-anchor_start})
    conn.execute("SET statement_timeout='5s'")
    if not args.cases and args.cache_state=="warm" and not args.updates:
        correctness(conn,args,queries)
    emit(args.out,{"kind":"run_start","rows":rows,"variant":args.variant,"cache_state":args.cache_state,
                   "samples_per_case":args.samples,"workers":args.workers,"concurrent_updates":args.updates,
                   "queries":queries})
    stop=threading.Event()
    counter=[]
    initial_max=conn.execute("SELECT max(n) FROM torrents").fetchone()[0]
    updater=threading.Thread(target=writer,args=(args,stop,counter)) if args.updates else None
    load_start=time.perf_counter()
    if updater:
        updater.start()
    jobs=[(name,sql,i) for i in range(args.samples) for name,sql in queries.items()]
    timed_out=set()
    if args.cache_state=="warm":
        for name,sql in queries.items():
            try:
                result=conn.execute(sql).fetchall()
                verify_page(conn,args,name,result)
            except psycopg.Error as err:
                emit(args.out,{"kind":"warmup_error","case":name,"sqlstate":err.sqlstate})
                if err.sqlstate=='57014':
                    timed_out.add(name)
                else:
                    raise
    random.Random(4501).shuffle(jobs)
    start=time.perf_counter()
    def worker(part):
        with connect(args.dsn) as worker_conn:
            for name,sql,i in part:
                if name in timed_out:
                    emit(args.out,{"kind":"sample_skipped","case":name,"sample":i,"reason":"prior timeout"})
                    continue
                try:
                    ms,result=timed(worker_conn,sql)
                    emit(args.out,{"kind":"sample","rows":rows,"variant":args.variant,
                      "cache_state":args.cache_state,"updates":args.updates,"case":name,"sample":i,
                      "ms":ms,"count":len(result),"digest":digest(result)})
                except psycopg.Error as err:
                    emit(args.out,{"kind":"sample_error","rows":rows,"variant":args.variant,
                      "cache_state":args.cache_state,"updates":args.updates,"case":name,"sample":i,
                      "sqlstate":err.sqlstate})
                    if err.sqlstate=='57014':
                        timed_out.add(name)
                    else:
                        raise
    try:
        with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=args.workers) as executor:
            futures=[executor.submit(worker,jobs[i::args.workers]) for i in range(args.workers)]
            for future in futures:
                future.result()
    finally:
        stop.set()
        if updater:
            updater.join(timeout=35)
    seconds=time.perf_counter()-start
    emit(args.out,{"kind":"update_summary","variant":args.variant,"rows":rows,
                   "seconds":time.perf_counter()-load_start,"query_seconds":seconds,
                   "updated_rows":sum(x.get('rows',0) for x in counter),
                   "inserted_rows":sum(x.get('inserted_rows',0) for x in counter),"batches":counter})
    if args.ingest:
        # Restore the exact initial corpus before comparing another variant.
        # Remove only this run's synthetic tail, in FK order, within one transaction.
        conn.execute("SET statement_timeout='180s'")
        with conn.transaction():
            for table in ['quarantined','torrent_files','annotations','torrent_contents']:
                conn.execute(f"DELETE FROM {table} WHERE info_hash IN (SELECT info_hash FROM torrents WHERE n>%s)",(initial_max,))
            deleted=conn.execute("DELETE FROM torrents WHERE n>%s",(initial_max,)).rowcount
        emit(args.out,{"kind":"synthetic_tail_cleanup","deleted_torrents":deleted,"initial_max":initial_max})
        conn.execute("SET statement_timeout='5s'")
    if any('error' in batch for batch in counter):
        raise RuntimeError('concurrent writer failed; inspect retained batch errors')
    for name,sql in queries.items():
        if args.cache_state=="first_touch":
            continue
        try:
            plan=conn.execute("EXPLAIN (ANALYZE,BUFFERS,WAL,SETTINGS,FORMAT JSON) "+sql).fetchone()[0]
            emit(args.out,{"kind":"plan","rows":rows,"variant":args.variant,"case":name,"plan":plan})
        except psycopg.Error as err:
            emit(args.out,{"kind":"plan_error","case":name,"sqlstate":err.sqlstate})
            if err.sqlstate!='57014':raise
    if args.cache_state!='first_touch':
        storage(conn,args)


def indexes(conn,args):
    conn.execute("SET statement_timeout=0")
    if args.variant in ['selected','retained']:
        # Qualify the compact serving set separately: the raw B-tree cannot
        # implement @@, and current episode predicates do not use whole-JSON GIN.
        conn.execute('CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm WITH SCHEMA public')
        excluded=['tc_episodes_gin','raw_tsv_gin']
        if args.variant=='retained':excluded+=['tc_page','tc_type_page']
        statements=[sql for sql in CANDIDATE_INDEXES if not any(x in sql for x in excluded)]
        statements.append(RAW_SUBSTRING_INDEX)
        statements.append(IDENTITY_PAGE_INDEX)
        for sql in statements:
            start=time.perf_counter()
            statement=sql.replace('CREATE INDEX ','CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS ')
            conn.execute(statement)
            emit(args.out,{"kind":"index_change","variant":args.variant,"sql":statement,"seconds":time.perf_counter()-start})
        removed=['raw_tsv_btree','raw_tsv_gin','tc_episodes_gin']
        if args.variant=='retained':removed+=['tc_page','tc_type_page']
        for name in removed:
            start=time.perf_counter()
            statement='DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS '+name
            conn.execute(statement)
            emit(args.out,{"kind":"index_change","variant":args.variant,"sql":statement,"seconds":time.perf_counter()-start})
        conn.execute('ANALYZE')
        storage(conn,args)
        return
    conn.execute('DROP INDEX IF EXISTS tc_identity_page')
    conn.execute('DROP INDEX IF EXISTS raw_name_trgm')
    conn.execute('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS raw_tsv_btree ON torrents(tsv)')
    for sql in CANDIDATE_INDEXES:
        name=sql.split()[2]
        statement=(sql.replace("CREATE INDEX ","CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ") if args.variant=="candidate"
                   else "DROP INDEX IF EXISTS "+name)
        start=time.perf_counter()
        conn.execute(statement)
        emit(args.out,{"kind":"index_change","variant":args.variant,"sql":statement,"seconds":time.perf_counter()-start})
    conn.execute("ANALYZE")
    storage(conn,args)


def main():
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument("command",choices=["seed","run","indexes","storage","reindex"])
    p.add_argument("--dsn",default=os.environ.get("CATALOGUE_BENCH_DSN"))
    p.add_argument("--out",required=True)
    p.add_argument("--rows",type=int,default=2400000)
    p.add_argument("--batch",type=int,default=100000)
    p.add_argument("--keep-seed-indexes",action="store_true",help="retain query indexes during large fixture construction")
    p.add_argument("--samples",type=int,default=30)
    p.add_argument("--workers",type=int,default=1)
    p.add_argument("--updates",action="store_true")
    p.add_argument("--ingest",action="store_true",help="append real synthetic torrent/file transactions during updates, then remove that tail")
    p.add_argument("--disposable",action="store_true")
    p.add_argument("--variant",choices=["baseline","candidate","selected","retained"],default="baseline")
    p.add_argument("--cache-state",choices=["warm","first_touch"],default="warm")
    p.add_argument("--cases")
    p.add_argument("--disk-path",default=".")
    p.add_argument("--min-free-gib",type=int,default=100)
    args=p.parse_args()
    if not args.dsn:
        p.error("set CATALOGUE_BENCH_DSN to the disposable database")
    if not 1 <= args.rows <= 32000000 or not 1 <= args.workers <= 16 or args.samples<1:
        p.error("invalid workload bounds")
    if args.ingest and not args.updates:
        p.error("--ingest requires --updates")
    Path(args.out).parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    with connect(args.dsn) as conn:
        if args.command=="seed": seed(conn,args)
        elif args.command=="run": run(conn,args)
        elif args.command=="indexes": indexes(conn,args)
        elif args.command=="storage": storage(conn,args)
        else:
            start=time.perf_counter()
            conn.execute("SET statement_timeout=0")
            conn.execute("REINDEX SCHEMA catalogue_bench")
            emit(args.out,{"kind":"reindex","variant":args.variant,"seconds":time.perf_counter()-start})


if __name__=="__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Evict only a stopped, explicitly labeled synthetic container's DB files.

Run with permissions to read the dedicated Docker volume (usually sudo -n).
Never drops global caches. Storage-device caches are outside this measurement.
"""
import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
p.add_argument("container")
args = p.parse_args()
container = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["docker", "inspect", args.container]))[0]
if container["State"]["Running"]:
    raise SystemExit("refusing cache eviction while database is running")
if container["Config"].get("Labels", {}).get("purpose") != "disposable-synthetic-benchmark":
    raise SystemExit("refusing unlabeled container")
volumes = [m for m in container["Mounts"] if m["Destination"] == "/var/lib/postgresql/data" and m["Type"] == "volume"]
if len(volumes) != 1 or not volumes[0]["Name"].startswith("dh-waypoint-catalogue-bench-"):
    raise SystemExit("refusing non-benchmark volume")
root = Path(volumes[0]["Source"])
if (root / "PG_VERSION").read_text().strip() != "16":
    raise SystemExit("unexpected PostgreSQL data directory")
count = total = 0
for directory, _, files in os.walk(root):
    for name in files:
        file = Path(directory) / name
        if file.is_symlink() or not file.is_file():
            continue
        fd = os.open(file, os.O_RDONLY)
        try:
            os.posix_fadvise(fd, 0, 0, os.POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED)
            count += 1
            total += os.fstat(fd).st_size
        finally:
            os.close(fd)
print(json.dumps({"kind": "file_cache_eviction", "files": count, "bytes": total}))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Record resource counters of one labeled disposable benchmark container."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import time

p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
p.add_argument("container")
p.add_argument("out")
args = p.parse_args()
metadata = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["docker", "inspect", args.container]))[0]
if metadata["Config"].get("Labels", {}).get("purpose") != "disposable-synthetic-benchmark":
    raise SystemExit("refusing unlabeled container")
Path(args.out).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
while True:
    try:
        data = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["docker", "stats", "--no-stream", "--format", "{{json .}}", args.container]))
        row = {key: data[key] for key in ["CPUPerc", "MemUsage", "MemPerc", "BlockIO", "PIDs"]}
        current=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["docker","inspect",args.container]))[0]
        if current['State']['Running']:
            pid=current['State']['Pid']
            try:
                relative=next(line.split(':',2)[2] for line in Path(f'/proc/{pid}/cgroup').read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('0::'))
                cgroup=Path('/sys/fs/cgroup')/relative.lstrip('/')
                row['container_started_at']=current['State']['StartedAt']
                for name in ['memory.current','memory.peak']:
                    row[name]=int((cgroup/name).read_text())
                for name in ['memory.stat','cpu.stat','io.stat']:
                    row[name]=(cgroup/name).read_text()
            except (OSError,StopIteration,ValueError):
                row['cgroup_counters_unavailable']=True
        row["at"] = time.time()
        with open(args.out, "a") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        pass
    time.sleep(5)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compare parameter-sensitive custom/generic plans on the same fixture."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import os
from pathlib import Path
import time

from psycopg import sql
import psycopg

import bench

p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
p.add_argument("--out",required=True)
p.add_argument("--variant",required=True)
p.add_argument("--samples",type=int,default=30)
p.add_argument('--cases',help='optional comma-separated prepared cases')
args=p.parse_args()
raw_policy=bench.ELIGIBLE.replace('=tc.info_hash','=raw.info_hash')
identity=("SELECT tc.id,tc.info_hash FROM torrent_contents tc WHERE "
          "tc.content_type=$1 AND tc.content_source=$2 AND tc.content_id=$3 AND "+bench.ELIGIBLE+
          " ORDER BY "+bench.ORDER+" LIMIT 100")
filtered_identity=identity.replace(' AND '+bench.ELIGIBLE,
    " AND tc.video_resolution='2160p' AND (tc.episodes #> '{0}'='{}'::jsonb OR "
    "tc.episodes #> '{0}' @> '{\"4\":{}}'::jsonb) AND "+bench.ELIGIBLE)
external=("SELECT tc.id,tc.info_hash FROM torrent_contents tc WHERE "
          "(tc.content_type,tc.content_source,tc.content_id) IN (VALUES ($1,$2,$3) "
          "UNION ALL SELECT content_type,content_source,content_id FROM content_attributes "
          "WHERE content_type=$1 AND source=$2 AND value=$3 AND key='id') AND "+bench.ELIGIBLE+
          " ORDER BY "+bench.ORDER+" LIMIT 100")
raw=("SELECT encode(raw.info_hash,'hex') AS id,raw.info_hash FROM torrents raw "
     "WHERE raw.tsv @@ $1::tsquery AND "+raw_policy+" ORDER BY raw.info_hash LIMIT 100")
substring=("SELECT encode(raw.info_hash,'hex') AS id,raw.info_hash FROM torrents raw "
           "WHERE raw.name ILIKE $1 AND "+bench.raw_serving_policy()+" ORDER BY raw.info_hash LIMIT 101")
raw_cursor=("SELECT encode(raw.info_hash,'hex') AS id,raw.info_hash FROM torrents raw "
            "WHERE raw.info_hash>decode($1,'hex') AND "+bench.raw_serving_policy()+" ORDER BY raw.info_hash LIMIT 101")
cases={
    "identity_hot":(identity,["tv_show","synthetic","1"]),
    "identity_rare":(identity,["movie","synthetic","123456"]),
    "identity_episode_quality":(filtered_identity,["tv_show","synthetic","1"]),
    "external_keyset":(external,["movie","imdb","tt123456"]),
